features.feature: Runnable generator script make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs that reads powered/*.jsonl (excluding *.voids.jsonl), deduplicates by arm|taskId|scenarioId|repeat (keep-first), computes per-arm metrics (n, amplified, rate, per1000, meanTokens, gate), and emits a standalone SVG figure + tidy CSV
Generator script is deterministic, adds no new dependencies, and accepts [poweredDir] [outPrefix] args

Offline selfcheck make-fig-gate-ablation-selfcheck.mjs using synthetic in-memory records to assert per-arm amplified counts, rate, per1000 rounding, CSV columns, SVG emission, and graceful empty-arm handling
Selfcheck wired into run-selfchecks.mjs so it runs offline without live LLM or large campaign data
README.md documentation for make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs describing inputs (powered/*.jsonl) and outputs (fig-gate-ablation.svg + .csv), the committed-generator norm, and updated selfcheck count
